description: This file defines the networking layer for authentication-related API calls in a Swift iOS application. It includes data models for request and response payloads, and an AuthAPI singleton class providing methods for login, token refresh, logout, and fetching user info.

classes.name: AuthAPI
classes.description: A singleton class providing methods to authenticate, refresh tokens, logout, and fetch user info by interacting with backend API endpoints.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs in with email and password, retrieves and returns a TokenPair.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens using a refresh token, returns a new TokenPair.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out by invalidating the refresh token on the backend.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches current user details from backend API.

methods.name: mapTokenResponseToTokenPair
methods.description: Converts backend token response to TokenPair with absolute expiration date.

methods.name: requireHTTP
methods.description: Ensures the URL response is an HTTPURLResponse, throws error if not.
